text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I spotted Bamboo Memory and Inari One being consulted by another student.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—So what're you sayin'?
There's a ghost settled in the mountain near the academy?

text_block_list.name: Frightened Student
text_block_list.text: Yes! Lately it's been coming down to the academy, and they say it's even haunting the dorms...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hmph... That is unacceptable for the academy's public morals...!

text_block_list.name: Anxious Student
text_block_list.text: A-And apparently it comes right into rooms, so tons of girls can't sleep...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What're ya worryin' about!
Even if somethin' like that shows up, I'll take care of it in a jiffy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's Inari-senpai for you!
A true paragon of chivalrous spirit!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Naturally! I can't just stand by with my mouth shut when our juniors are in trouble!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
In that case, of course I'll help too!
Well then, right away—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We've gotta march straight up the mountain and discipline that rumored ghost!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Strike while the iron is hot!
Come on, let's move! Inari-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaagh?!
W-Wait, let go of me?!
I ain't mentally prepared yet...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pulling a flustered Inari One by the hand,
Bamboo Memory dashed off at incredible speed—or so it seemed.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops, almost forgot!
Hey there, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
In terms of disciplinary standards, it's not good for students to head into the mountains alone!
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—We need you to accompany us as our guardian!
Please, we're counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, I ended up getting dragged along—er, accompanying them to the rumored mountain.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hey, Bamboo.
Ever since a while ago, I feel like someone's watchin' us...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No problem! If it's just watching, that means it's terrified of us and too scared to make a move!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! You bet!
If we team up, there's nothin' to be scared of—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, t-t-this is bad!
I-It's suddenly gettin' dark around here?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as she spoke, the surroundings grew darker and darker...
An indescribably eerie presence was gradually thickening...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah, here it comes.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
W-W-We gotta get out of here quick!
That nasty presence is gettin' thicker...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ooh, it's getting closer and closer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Alright! Over there!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —YAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...With a roaring shout of fighting spirit, Bamboo Memory struck a tree with her shinai.
Immediately, the ominous atmosphere and darkness enveloping the area scattered away—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Alright! Looks like that's one point for us!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
W-We're saved, then...?
Still, Bamboo, how'd you know how to exorcise spirits...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh? I didn't know at all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No problem, though!
In a brawl, all you need is a blast of pure fighting spirit!
Whoever scares the other first wins!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's just a line borrowed from a school drama I saw once!
I'm just glad we punished it properly!

...What if the ghost hadn't gotten scared?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory

I'm just glad we punished it properly!
choice_data_list: Anyway, we can rest easy now
Anyway, we can rest easy now

...What if the ghost hadn't gotten scared?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If that happened, Inari-senpai and I would just combine our powers and hit it with a wave of fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, I would've preferred that since it sounds more hot-blooded.
Well, we accomplished our goal, so it's all good!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...B-Bamboo, you really are something else...
I-I'm honestly dumbfounded, sheesh...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Well. All's well that ends well, since that thing scurried off quietly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It felt like we crossed quite a dangerous bridge...
Regardless, the case seemed settled.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
G-Great combo, you say... but I couldn't do a single thing.
I don't need your pity...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?! You're the one who volunteered to defeat it first, Senpai!
To protect our juniors!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I only pumped myself up because I didn't want to bring shame upon you, Senpai!
It's all thanks to you, Inari-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
B-Bamboo...! Ghhh...!
I sure got myself a fine junior...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Fwahaha... From now on, whenever a spirit disrupts academy discipline, leave it to me and Inari-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You got it! Now everyone at the academy can live in peace!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, for a second there I wondered how things'd turn out.
Sure glad you were around, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
As long as Inari-senpai and I are around!
Whether our opponent's a ghost or whatever, we won't let anyone who breaches public morals get away with it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After that. Word of this incident spread,
and requests for ghost extermination flooded in for Bamboo Memory and Inari One.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
With this, everyone at the academy can rest easy—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What's the matter?
Shutting up all of a sudden like that.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh, I kinda feel like there's still
a faint, creepy presence lingering around...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe that ghost hasn't learned its lesson yet!
I gotta be thorough and deliver one more strike!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on a sec!
Don't leave me behind in a place like this~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Case closed!
Well then, let's head back to the academy right away.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's not like I wanna stick around
in a place like this any longer anyway.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's wrong with you?
You're looking awfully weighed down...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...If you have enough fighting spirit, you can drive ghosts away.
If so... what about a human who was trembling in fear and lacked that spirit...?
